gui_context: Stats 菜单与各级子菜单的完整 Lore 句子。Wiki 的旧版 Stats 可点击 UI 确认按钮与分层；实时采集确认新版文字、图标及变色边界。

lines.context: 固定加成数值的合算方式
lines.raw: §7All of these are summed together into a base amount.
lines.text: All of these are summed together into a base amount.
lines.gloss: 两条英文 Lore 构成一句；GUI_Lore 跨行匹配，不单独译第一行。
lines.zh: 这些加成会相加，得到基础数值。

lines.raw: §7These stat bonuses are added up and then converted into the (additive) multiplier.
lines.text: These stat bonuses are added up and then converted into the (additive) multiplier.
lines.gloss: 加算增益先相加，再换算乘数。
lines.zh: 这些属性加成会先相加，再换算为加算倍率。

lines.context: Wiki 深入来源菜单中的固有属性说明
lines.raw: §8This is the base value of this stat which everybody starts with.
lines.text: This is the base value of this stat which everybody starts with.
lines.gloss: 固有值对所有玩家相同；Wiki UI 的按钮 Lore。
lines.zh: 所有玩家初始拥有的该属性基础值。

lines.context: Wiki 按类别汇总开关说明
lines.raw: §7Groups all modifiers from the same category into one.
lines.text: Groups all modifiers from the same category into one.
lines.gloss: Wiki 可点击子菜单里的按钮说明。
lines.zh: 将同一类别的属性修正合并显示。

lines.context: Wiki 展开属性明细的开关说明
lines.raw: §7Breaks down modifiers on items so you can compare them individually.
lines.text: Breaks down modifiers on items so you can compare them individually.
lines.gloss: 不改变实际物品数值。
lines.zh: 分别展开物品上的各项属性修正，方便逐项比较。

lines.context: 切换显示全部/仅有属性，绿色 ALL 高亮
lines.raw: §7Toggle whether you want to see §aALL §7SkyBlock statistics, or just the ones you have.
lines.text: Toggle whether you want to see ALL SkyBlock statistics, or just the ones you have.
lines.gloss: SkyBlock 留给名称选项处理；ALL 的绿色单独保留。
lines.zh: 选择显示全部 SkyBlock 属性，或只显示你拥有的属性。

segments.text: Toggle whether you want to see
SkyBlock statistics, or just the ones you have.
segments.zh: SkyBlock 属性，或只显示你拥有的属性。

lines.raw: §7Your True Defense stat reduces the true damage that you take from enemies.
lines.text: Your True Defense stat reduces the true damage that you take from enemies.
lines.gloss: 真实伤害不受普通防御力抵消。
lines.zh: 真实防御可降低你受到的敌方真实伤害。

lines.context: 凶暴的连击次数及每 100 点额外攻击
lines.raw: §7Ferocity grants percent chance to double-strike enemies. Increments of 100 increases the base number of strikes.
lines.text: Ferocity grants percent chance to double-strike enemies. Increments of 100 increases the base number of strikes.
lines.gloss: 每 100 点增加一次基础连击次数，不是暴击伤害。
lines.zh: 凶暴使你有一定几率对敌人再次发动攻击。每累计 100 点凶暴，基础额外攻击次数 +1。

lines.raw: §7Increases your melee hit range.
lines.text: Increases your melee hit range.
lines.gloss: 仅近战命中距离，不影响弓。
lines.zh: 增加近战攻击的命中范围。

lines.raw: §7Ability Damage increases the damage applied by certain spells and item abilities.
lines.text: Ability Damage increases the damage applied by certain spells and item abilities.
lines.gloss: 部分法术与物品技能，不是所有普通攻击。
lines.zh: 提高部分法术与物品技能造成的伤害。

lines.raw: §7Health Regen increases the amount of health that you naturally regenerate over time.
lines.text: Health Regen increases the amount of health that you naturally regenerate over time.
lines.gloss: 自然恢复的生命值，不是治疗技能。
lines.zh: 提高你随时间自然恢复的生命值。

lines.raw: §7Vitality is a resource, similar to Mana, but for healing abilities.
lines.text: Vitality is a resource, similar to Mana, but for healing abilities.
lines.gloss: 以实机文字为准：这是治疗技能使用的资源。
lines.zh: 活力与法力类似，是治疗技能所需的资源。

lines.raw: §7Mining Spread is the chance to automatically mine adjacent blocks when mining Blocks, Ores, and Dwarven Metals.
lines.text: Mining Spread is the chance to automatically mine adjacent blocks when mining Blocks, Ores, and Dwarven Metals.
lines.gloss: Blocks、Ores、Dwarven Metals 指三种采矿对象。
lines.zh: 挖掘方块、矿石或矮人金属时，有几率自动挖掘相邻方块。

lines.raw: §7Gemstone Spread is the chance to automatically mine adjacent blocks when mining Gemstones.
lines.text: Gemstone Spread is the chance to automatically mine adjacent blocks when mining Gemstones.
lines.gloss: 仅宝石，不套用普通方块的范围。
lines.zh: 挖掘宝石时，有几率自动挖掘相邻方块。

lines.raw: §7Pristine is the chance to increase the quality of a Gemstone when it's dropped.
lines.text: Pristine is the chance to increase the quality of a Gemstone when it's dropped.
lines.gloss: 掉落宝石时提升品质的概率。
lines.zh: 掉落宝石时，纯净决定其品质提升的几率。

lines.raw: §7Sweep is the ability to cut multiple logs at once.
lines.text: Sweep is the ability to cut multiple logs at once.
lines.gloss: 原木而非树苗。
lines.zh: 横扫使你一次可砍伐多个原木。

lines.raw: §7Timber is the chance to fell the entire tree on your first melee axe cut.
lines.text: Timber is the chance to fell the entire tree on your first melee axe cut.
lines.gloss: 只有第一斧近战挥砍才判定。
lines.zh: 首次使用斧头近战砍击树木时，整树砍伐决定一斧砍倒整棵树的几率。

lines.context: 奖杯几率说明；实测绯红岛与莲花环礁两处地点
lines.raw: §7Increases your chance to catch §6Trophies §7while fishing on the §cCrimson Isle §7and §3Lotus Atoll§7.
lines.text: Increases your chance to catch Trophies while fishing on the Crimson Isle and Lotus Atoll.
lines.gloss: Wiki 2026-08 的 UI 尚只记绯红岛，本轮实测加了 Lotus Atoll；地点及奖杯鱼颜色按实机保留。
lines.zh: 在绯红岛与莲花环礁钓鱼时，提高钓到奖杯鱼的几率。

lines.raw: §7Pressure Resistance reduces the effects of Pressure when diving.
lines.text: Pressure Resistance reduces the effects of Pressure when diving.
lines.gloss: 潜水时的压力，不是防御力。
lines.zh: 抗压可降低潜水时受到的压力影响。

lines.raw: §7Makes Primal Fears spawn more often and reduces damage taken from Primal Fears.
lines.text: Makes Primal Fears spawn more often and reduces damage taken from Primal Fears.
lines.gloss: Primal Fears 沿用既有宠物 Lore 的“原始恐惧”译名。
lines.zh: 使原始恐惧更频繁地出现，并降低你受到它们的伤害。

lines.raw: §7Pull dictates both which fish you're able to grab and how long it takes using a fishing net.
lines.text: Pull dictates both which fish you're able to grab and how long it takes using a fishing net.
lines.gloss: 决定可捕捞鱼种与渔网耗时。
lines.zh: 拉力决定渔网能捕到哪些鱼，以及捕捞所需的时间。

lines.context: 各类智慧对对应技能经验获取量的影响
lines.text: %1$s increases how much %2$s Skill XP that you gain.

placeholders.desc: 完整属性名，如 Mining Wisdom

lines.gloss: 首参必须是完整智慧属性名，沿用挖掘智慧与挖矿技能的既定区别；不按采集职业值写死。
lines.zh: %1$s提高你获得的%2$s技能经验。

lines.context: 魔法寻宝的稀有掉落说明
lines.raw: §7Magic Find increases how many rare items you find.
lines.text: Magic Find increases how many rare items you find.
lines.gloss: 与 Pet Luck 的宠物几率不同。
lines.zh: 魔法寻宝提高你发现稀有物品的几率。

lines.raw: §7Pet Luck increases how many pets you find.
lines.text: Pet Luck increases how many pets you find.
lines.gloss: 宠物幸运不是魔法寻宝。
lines.zh: 宠物幸运提高你发现宠物的几率。

lines.context: 抗热可延长高温环境停留时间
lines.raw: §7Heat Resistances increases the amount of time you can spend in hot environments.
lines.text: Heat Resistances increases the amount of time you can spend in hot environments.
lines.gloss: 服务器的 Resistances 拼法按实测保留；抗热不叫炎热抗性。
lines.zh: 抗热延长你在炎热环境中的活动时间。

lines.context: 抗寒可延长寒冷环境停留时间
lines.raw: §7Cold Resistance increases the amount of time you can spend in cold environments.
lines.text: Cold Resistance increases the amount of time you can spend in cold environments.
lines.gloss: 同一属性系列的抗寒机制。
lines.zh: 抗寒延长你在寒冷环境中的活动时间。

lines.context: 花园额外害虫刷出概率
lines.raw: §7Chance to spawn bonus §2 Pests §7while on §aThe Garden§7.
lines.text: Chance to spawn bonus  Pests while on The Garden.
lines.gloss: 绿色害虫图标及花园地名各自保留原始颜色。
lines.zh: 在花园中刷出额外 害虫的几率。

lines.context: 狩猎时遇到行踪不定生物的机会
lines.raw: §7Increases your chances of finding §d Elusive §7mobs while doing certain activities.
lines.text: Increases your chances of finding  Elusive mobs while doing certain activities.
lines.gloss: Elusive 是狩猎稀有度，与普通随机怪物区分。
lines.zh: 进行特定活动时，遇到行踪不定生物的几率提高。

lines.context: 狩猎分类属性对狩猎速度和碎片掉落的作用
lines.raw: §7Stats that influence how quickly you hunt mobs and how many shards you get for doing so.
lines.text: Stats that influence how quickly you hunt mobs and how many shards you get for doing so.
lines.gloss: 不是任何一个具体属性，而是 Hunting 分类的概述。
lines.zh: 这些属性影响你的狩猎速度，以及狩猎时获得的碎片数量。

lines.context: 智慧分类属性对技能经验的作用
lines.raw: §7Stats that influence how much §3Skill XP §7you gain.
lines.text: Stats that influence how much Skill XP you gain.
lines.gloss: Skill XP 原文蓝色，中文经验仍在蓝色段。
lines.zh: 这些属性影响你获得的技能经验。

segments.zh: 这些属性影响你获得的

lines.raw: §7Extends underwater breathing time.
lines.text: Extends underwater breathing time.
lines.gloss: 呼吸时长而非泳速。
lines.zh: 延长水下呼吸时间。

lines.raw: §cDisabled by: §fPrivate Island §7(Use the Public Islands or The Garden)
lines.text: Disabled by: Private Island (Use the Public Islands or The Garden)
lines.gloss: 私岛不可用；仅在公共岛屿或花园生效。
lines.zh: 不生效: 私人岛屿 (请前往公共岛屿或花园)

segments.text: (Use the Public Islands or The Garden)
